column6: A pig digging in the house.

A pig which was about to be slaughtered by the pig-butcher squealed. (The butcher said:) @q{“Your ancestors and forebears walked this road, and now you too are walking it, so why are you squealing?”}
Like a pig …… your dagger …….

Like a gazelle he is drinking 15 days' worth of water.
@q{“Get that bear away from us!”} -- so he has gone to the mountains.

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.2.3,t623.h57]{6.2.3: UET 6/2 241}} A bear in the sixth month turned onto its side and said: @q{“Were @wDN{An} not to give you, oh sleep, to a person, as he does to me -- they would die.”}
@note{cf. @xref[t.6.2.3,t623.h58]{6.2.3: UET 6/2 294}} Like a hyena, you will not eat it unless it stinks.
The claws of a cat can walk even in sheep fat.
As with a cat, it is its tongue that treats its skin.
A cat can find a hole in the ground.
A fox stamped on the crotch of an elephant: @q{“It's enough, it's too much!”}

A fox demanded of @wDN{Enlil} the horns of a wild bull. While it was wearing the wild bull's horns, it started to rain. But the horns rose high above him, so he could not enter his burrow. Until midnight the wind kept blowing, and the clouds brought rain. Afterwards, when it had stopped raining on him, and he had dried off, he said: @q{“I shall return this feature to its rightful owner!”}
A fox was pursuing the testicles of a wild bull, as though about to die of hunger.
A fox was scrabbling in a dyke: @q{“Nobody has ever seen my bent-over behind.”}

Don't expect me to stay the night!”}

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.2.3,t623.h63]{6.2.3: UET 6/2 220}} A fox went into a den in a thorny bush, and (the dog said:) @q{“Hey, come out!”} But it would not come out. @q{“How am I supposed to get in from out here?”} (exclaimed the dog). @q{“So long as you don't chase me away, I will stay sitting here!”} said the fox.
The fox ……. He is more full of lies than anyone.
Like an aroused fox, your cry echoes over the fields.
What will the dog do about what the fox is doing?

A fox walked around a throw-stick: @q{“Who is going to give a party as good as that?”}
A fox had been caught by a partially-sighted man: @q{“Is this why you are crying?”} The fox replied: @q{“Set me free!”}
